content.short: Frens On Chain is a 100% on-chain generated dynamic NFT pet in an interactive blockchain game.
content.description: Frens On Chain is an interactive blockchain game in which players mint unique digital pets, Frens, using 100% on-chain generation. Players care for their Frens on a daily basis through activities like feeding, playing, and cleaning, aiming to maintain Happiness, Energy, and Cleanliness. Each Fren is a dynamic NFT: its appearance and mood evolve as care is given. The design emphasizes on-chain permanence and rewards long-term engagement through ongoing community interaction among players.
